game_title: Condition Builder – Exit Light Ledge Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: In Exit Light Ledge, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the stone seal using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The stone seal reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the stone seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
